Keep Local Product Intent—Add Hilton Honors: retain Hilton Garden Inn's brand promise while accessing loyalty earn/redeem and parent commercial systems a standalone hotel cannot buy alone.
Upper-midscale select-service: evening F&B, flexible meetings pods, and Hilton Honors for travelers needing more than limited-service without full-service capital.

Operator & Owner Fit: strongest when the asset can deliver the brand's guest promise with QA discipline—weakest when sponsors want the flag without the product investment.
